description: This file defines the ObjectCopier class within the Aws\S3 namespace. The class provides functionality to perform object copy operations between S3 locations, utilizing multipart copy when appropriate. It handles asynchronous and synchronous copying, validates locations, and constructs necessary commands for AWS SDK interactions.

classes.name: ObjectCopier
classes.description: A class to copy objects between S3 locations, potentially using multipart copy for large objects. Implements asynchronous and synchronous copy operations with configurable options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ObjectCopier with an S3 client, source and destination locations, ACL, and options. Validates the locations.

methods.name: promise
methods.description: Performs the copy operation asynchronously, returning a PromiseInterface. Decides between multipart copy and single copy based on object size.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Performs the copy operation synchronously by waiting for the promise to resolve and returns the result.

methods.name: validateLocation
methods.description: Ensures that the provided location array has non-empty 'Bucket' and 'Key' entries.

methods.name: getSourcePath
methods.description: Constructs and returns the source path string for the copy operation, handling ARNs and version IDs.
